verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a hosted user-management SaaS like Clerk, but the pack documents no export-out capability. The migration docs and open-source JSON/CSV tool cover importing users into Clerk, not exporting data from it, and the public Backend API/OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block someone could use to build an export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
